notes.title: Post-Series Changelog
notes.content:
[p]cool kid cody's done, but the updates aren't. here's a list of stuff that's been updated, and a heads up about some of the episodes going free tomorrow, read below!

[b]version 3.29[/b][/p][list][*][p]code has been updated in preparation for episodes s1e2, s1e3, s2e2, and s2e3 becoming free tomorrow (june 14, thanks for your patience while we figure that out)! from now on, those who get those episodes for free will not get the badge, (it'll remain exclusive to those who paid to play those episodes earlier on). thank you again for all your support! as a heads up, [b]your badges are tied to the persistent file located in the local files (Steam > steamapps > common > Cool Kid Cody > game > saves). if you plan on reinstalling the game/wiping your computer and are concerned about losing your badge, back up that persistent file![/b] if you believe you should have the badge but don't, or want to report any bug really, email us at [url="https://90percentstudios@gmail.com"]90percentstudios@gmail.com[/url] or bug us on social media. (i'm going to be out of town this weekend but i'll get back to you asap!! - denny)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed the finale so mini pastes the new photos into the yearbook whether you've only found 1 photo or all 3 (she used to only do it if it were all 3).[/p][/*][*][p]made it so even if you only get the third unlockable photo in the finale, it'll still turn to dusk on the beach.[/p][/*][*][p]added alternate episode icons that show whether you’ve unlocked the chillectrical move for that episode.[/p][/*][*][p]edited color of peter’s eyes in his sword sprite, the gray shade was too dark before.[/p][/*][*][p]edited tight heights so crescent high in the distance had its new design in the finale[/p][/*][*][p]moved some character positioning during the finale during pie’s scene so he wouldn’t be blocked by the textbox as much.[/p][/*][*][p]reformatted episode titles in the episode selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]made textboxes slightly transparent to show more bg/character art behind it. as  a result we reorganized textbox files so that text tails are no longer separate .pngs from the textbox itself. makes it easier to edit n all that![/p][/*][*][p]increased space around the title of each menu to prep for larger text sizes for the mobile version.[/p][/*][*][p]reformatted credits slightly.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.30[/b][/p][list][*][p]added white outline to olive/coffee shop barista's head in s3e10.[/p][/*][*][p]made andy and me average in the after-credits scene.[/p][/*][*][p]gave daniel his friendship bracelet in his bg sprite.[/p][/*][*][p]gave cody his friendship bracelet and earring in his average fallen down sprite.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed shading on peter’s phone on the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed mix-up between shoe grind and nollie star ratings in s3e4.[/p][/*][*][p]gave loser-bruce a curl on his head, he had one in his background sprite but not on his close-up one[/p][/*][*][p]gave cody’s handspring sprite a slight purple edge along the board.[/p][/*][*][p]cody’s dash sprite had hexagonal wheels when they should’ve been pentagons. fixed it so it was more in style with the other sprites.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.32[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed a few typos and line breaking issues in s3e5 + e6[/p][/*][*][p]fixed scene in s3e6 in g-ma’s garage, she faces right during cody’s conversation when she should be facing left. [/p][/*][*][p]fixed issue where finale credits scene broke the game.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed cody’s textbox not appearing in s3e5 when he’s a kid.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.37[/b][/p][list][*][p]added game version number to info screen[/p][/*][*][p]fixed kay’s eyes appearing gray in episode 23[/p][/*][*][p]fixed game crashing at end of s2e10[/p][/*][*][p]fixed peter showing up twice in the classroom background of s1e10[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.37[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed sky in front of school in s2e4, hovering over the button showed chill haven in the wrong position.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed some line breaking issues/the pacing of some lines/combined some lines here and there.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed s2e5 unlockable photo #2, peggy’s contacts were the wrong shade of blue.[/p][/*][*][p]tweaked s2e7 unlockable photo #2 slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]improved readability of icons on main menu screen.
[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]version 3.40[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed bug where, in s3e9 you could click on the background to initiate the boat scene during the second part of cody's fight with rhyme.[/p][/*][*][p]made it so, in the episode selection menu, clicking on unowned episodes causes steam's overlay to open up to the episode's dlc.[/p][/*][*][p]added buttons to buy the season bundles if you don't already own it. if you own all seasons, this button won't appear.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed bug where some peoples' badges weren't showing up. it shouldn't be tied to your persistent file anymore, but tied to information stored in steam itself, so even if you uninstall+reinstall the game, the badge shouldn't disappear![/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.41[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed desktop stickers disappearing too soon on the left side of the screen. now the stickers should float off the screen before popping out of existence.[/p][/*][*][p]made mini’s mouth red instead of pink in s3e6’s chillectrical move.[/p][/*][*][p]made cody’s mouth pink instead of red in his conversation with holy resources.[/p][/*][*][p]made it so cody’s outfit looks all floaty when he’s talking to pb in s3e7.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.81[/b][/p][list][*][p]the big jump in version number is from having made 40 other versions to try and get this build to also work on google play. it works on both now![/p][/*][*][p]made the error pop up window on the disc selection menu smaller so you can see cody’s silly face on the wallpaper even when the menu's open.[/p][/*][*][p]s1e3: fixed a bug where the narrator is speaking when cody should be speaking.[/p][/*][*][p]s3e10: cody says “i don’t think there’s anyone left around the beach that we can bug for signatures”, which isn’t technically true if you hadn’t gotten alarmy’s signature yet, in which case cody’s backpack will now rustle, reminding him to get their signature.[/p][/*][*][p]s3e10: added borders to the blank photos on the last page of the yearbook so they appeared more clickable.[/p][/*][*][p]s3e10: made it so the seating on the beach isn’t visible until cody enters the beach.[/p][/*][*][p]s3e10: made it so gg always has her bracelet. she used to only have her bracelet if you’d done the bracelet mini-quest in s3e7 (restarting also s3e7 reset her bracelet).[/p][/*][*][p]updated game icon so it's cuter.[/p][/*][*][p]made a bunch of other small fixes like typos and a few assets missing the 3d effect/white outlines.[/p][/*][*][p]reorganized some files in the etc folder, should have no effect on gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.86[/b][/p][list][*][p]update for the hellaween special :)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.87[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed a bug where peggy's grad outfit was missing her hat and didn't work on certain poses.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.93[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed rhyme’s average design (her shirt stripes were white instead of light gray).[/p][/*][*][p]added a white outline to rhyme’s phone menu in the special.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where achievements weren't registering. you may have to go back and redo the scenes wherever the achievement should've been granted, sorry about the inconvenience!![/p][/*][*][p]because of a new renpy update i had to change some code. this shouldn't affect gameplay but i know some people like to go through the code/mod things so i thought i'd note it. all instances of "im.MatrixColor" and other [url="https://www.renpy.org/doc/html/im.html"]image manipulators listed here[/url] aren't compatible anymore and have been replaced with an equivalent [url="https://www.renpy.org/doc/html/matrixcolor.html"]matrixcolor transform property[/url], and in a few cases, [url="https://www.renpy.org/doc/html/transform_properties.html"]other transform properties[/url]. this affects almost any code dealing with images in the game, and means code that looked like this:

im.MatrixColor ("images/bg_other/outshore/february/birds%s" %(image_extension), im.matrix.brightness(0.10))

now looks like this!

Transform ("images/bg_other/outshore/february/birds%s" %(image_extension), matrixcolor=BrightnessMatrix(value=0.10))
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.95[/b][/p][list][*][p]added id tags to each line of dialogue (doesn't affect gameplay, it's just in case we create translations and need to identify dialogue more specifically).[/p][/*][*][p]made gigi's friends have their regular names in s3e10.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]version 3.97[/b][/p][list][*][p]edited some episode icons for better visibility (namely s3e6 now has two lightning bolts, indicating there are two unlockable chillectrical moves for that episode!)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a visual bug on cody's meter in s3e6.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where in s3e6 if you interact with cody’s room entrance on both cody and mini's turn in the same round, g-ma will leave.[/p][/*][*][p]the last update apparently made peoples' persistent data inaccessible, this update should fix that (i think? it does for me at least :')[/p][/*][*][p]the song in sun's out fun's out was bugged and the piano wasn't playing. updated with a fix but didn't change the version number since this was just a file swap issue.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed the censor beep in s3e1, it would just keep looping foreeeeever.
 [/p][/*][/list][p] [b]version 4.02[/b][/p][list][*][p]changed the appearance of the arrow over stick's bridge so it overlapped less, folks were having trouble clicking it.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where sometimes, during the credits scene, the phone would disappear.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Free Episodes Announcement
notes.content:
hey y’all, denny here, i’ve got a special announcement to make in terms of the monetization of the game! instead of just the first episode being free, the first THREE episodes of each season will be free. more specifically:

[list]
[*]season 3’s first three episodes will be free upon launch!
[*]s1 episode 2, s1 episode 3, s2 episode 2 and s2 episode 3 will be [strike]made free on june 7th![/strike] edit: sorry for the wait, we had to confirm some things with steam first, the date will now be june 14th! thanks for your patience!)
[*]as a token of our appreciation to those who paid for those four episodes, you have been awarded the prestigious “#1 ckc fan badge” on the main menu of your game. yes, you alone, if you’re reading this and paid for any of those episodes, are the #1 fan. don’t tell anyone else. the badge changes depending on how many of those four episodes you’ve paid for. all you have to do is launch the game with the specific episode dlc active and the badge will become a part of your game!
[/list]

that’s the main stuff, but if you wanna see me rambling a little more, read on!

we decided to make more episodes free for a few reasons: i felt bad about all three seasons culminating to a total cost of $43ish USD (and that’s WITH the 20% discount from bundling). when i’d originally priced things i was going off of how we priced our other game, purrfect apawcalypse 3, which was $6.99 USD. divided by its 3.5 distinct “levels”, i thought $1.99 per episode of cool kid cody felt fair. now i feel like it’s a bit steep, especially since we’d like to eventually port cool kid cody to the google play store and offering such an expensive game on mobile feels unfair.

i also thought about upping the discount on the bundle instead, but didn’t want to bump up against steam’s caveat wherein the average price per item in a bundle must be at least $0.49 USD (and if we dip below that, the dlc won’t be visible to you at all). we’ve had a few issues with this before, especially when currencies suddenly inflate/we offer sales on top of the bundle, so i thought it’d be less complicated to lower the overall cost of the game by making more episodes free.

anyway, i waffled over how to do this in a way that’d be kind towards future players, but also appreciative of the players who supported us by paying for those first episodes as soon as they came out. i know it isn’t much, but i hope you enjoy the badge. your support helped us bring this massive project to completion and i can’t be thankful enough for you playing our games, participating in fundraisers and making amazing fan content. you’re seriously cool in the real way and we really appreciate you.

welp, that’s it for now, talk to you next week! :)

<3 denny and andy

heya everyone!! it's that time of year again, weekly releases of cool kid cody will be starting this friday, april 5th! in preparation we've started this new changelog which we'll be updating anytime we update the game for an episode release. if you're wondering if a bug's been fixed, it should be listed here, with most recent changes at the bottom! thanks and i hope you enjoy the new episodes. :)
- denny

notes.title: Post-Season Changelog!
notes.content:
bug fixes
* you are now able to attain "repolarization", the achievement for acing every chillectrical move in season 2! it looked like there was an issue with s2 episode 9 specifically, when you aced the move it did not contribute to the achievements requirements. it should be fixed now, but you may have to replay the aced move scene in ep 9!
* when gaining points in s2 episode 10, the fx would overlay with mini's wings still instead of her feather. have now fixed that!
* mini's sprite wouldn't animate out of the scene after speaking with konyami. fixed!
* fixed a bug where in s2 episode 7, if you clicked on dice while building a bot, it would return to the main menu after some dialogue. now you just return to usual bot-building gameplay!
* fixed some dialogue in s1 episode 7 where dialogue from the dream-whiteboard continued off of the dialogue box. added a line break.
* fixed a bug where cody's wink wasn't half pink!
* fixed a bug where the game wouldn't start up for some! ;-; sorry about that and thank you for your patience!!
* peter's bike was appearing in the wrong position if he was a cool kid and you clicked on his bike in his inventory.
* edited background OC roster.
* made episode names in the episode select menu clickable, and if the episode is locked then the name will appear grayed out.
* fixed a bug where (usually in the slanguage arts class, but could happen anywhere) depending on the combination of background OCs, the game would crash. pretty obscure, but it's been fixed now!

notes.title: Season 2 Changelog!
notes.content:
bug fixes as of version 2.18:
* you could click on the background buttons in nebuland while in the cutscene between juvie and pizza boy, interrupting the scene. that background buttons have been disabled during the cutscene now!
* edit: seems like this bug occurred whenever cody's inventory appeared/was replaced by another inventory, for example during the last scene of episode 5 when pizza boy's bike in his inventory appears. all instances of this bug have (hopefully) been fixed!
* edit: the bus in episode 6 wasn't flush with the left side of the screen, should be now.
* edit: there was a formatting error in episode 7 when cody interacts with the mall. line breaks were all wacky, should be fixed now.
* edit: made the behind the scenes content hidden in trash cans easier to get. before, you had to be very lucky to find them. now there's a 50% chance you'll find one per episode in any trash can.
* edit: the friendlicious fist bump achievement was unattainable due to a glitch. it's now been fixed. if you've already played through all the aced-chillectrical-move scenes, you may have to play through one again (any should work) in order to trigger the achievement.
* edit: on the phone's main navigation menu, your cursor turned into a hand when hovering over the phone button, even though clicking it would no nothing at that point. its now been fixed so your cursor doesn't turn into a hand.
* fixed a bug where you could click on episode icons even after you exited out of the episode selection menu.
* fixed a bug where you couldn't unlock achievements altogether. you should be able to unlock achievements now. if you'd unlocked say, all 3 photos in s1e1 and didn't get the achievement, you only need to go back and unlock 1 photo (any of them) to trigger the achievement pop up. same goes for if you did all chillectrical moves, you'll have to go back and do one (any) to trigger the pop up.
* fixed a bug that blocked you from getting the quiz kid achievement. you should be able to get it at the end of the quiz now.
* fixed a bug where pizza boy disappears from a photo in episode 3. happens when the game can't figure out what your original clothing choices were. the photo will  now default to showing pizza boy wearing the lame options in that case. you can still go back and play the episode and change what pizza boy was wearing in the photo.
* fixed a bug where hyperlinks don't cause the cursor to change on hover, unlike most other buttons.
* okay, not really a bug fix, but after that whole data wipe bug your episode icons might change to their "unread" state (just a little movie clip with play button icon) instead of their "read" state (for ep 1, a cat). you may have to play through again to get the icons back, OR if you want, [url= https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QYg7GXSzLNTFaZ7uQHYV_79bjarzXTry/view?usp=sharing]you can drop this .rpy file [/url]into the game files. just browse local files, and drop here: Steam>steamapps>common>CoolKidCody>game>scripts after doing that, upon loading any working save file, they will be marked as read. :)
* fixed a bug where cody starts out with 2 points of chill in ep 1. originally this was done as a bit of a tutorial move, so players could see the effects losing chillectricity would have on cody, but i realize this is a little inconsistent with the rest of the episodes where the playable character always starts out with the lowest level of chill. its been fixed now!
* fixed a bug where sometimes konyami would act like you had a "vessel" even if you didn't. also konyami would crash the game if you tried to talk to them at the start of episode 7 when cody's dreaming. 
* fixed it so you couldn't enter the gym in s2e2 (doing so caused scripts from s1e10 to play)
* episode title correction: episode 16 was accidentally labeled as 17 and episode 17 as 16.
* game crashed on start up for some people, likely related to something with the disk menu (more specifically, the variable "s1d2out"). it's since been fixed (hopefully!)
* for some users their photos, save data, etc might be wiped upon update. this may be because within the game's script files there are defaults set for each persistent variable. i've changed things so those defaults aren't necessary for most cases (with the exception of the behind the scenes files, still testing on that). 
* fixed bug where, when in game and opening the phone to look at photos, you could only see photos from within the season of the episode you were playing. also, if you were playing through a scene where you unlocked a photo, entering the menu during that scene and toggling through photos would cause the photo in game to also toggle, if that makes sense.
* fixed a bug where you couldn't toggle through photos during the credits. it seemed to get stuck on photo #3 of any episode.

notes.title: Cool Kid Cody's Massively Average Update! (And also a hugely cool sale)
notes.content:
hi everyone!! its that time of year again, when the skies turn pink, the moon grows 4 times its size and everyone's prepping for the end of the school year. cool kid cody's first year anniversary is coming up and to celebrate there's a huge sale! (we would've done 90% off but unfortunately you can't go under 0.49 USD, so 80% off it is.) the sale will last from [b]march 27th[/b] 10 am pdt to [b]april 3[/b] 10 am pdt (and affects [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23074/Purrfect_Apawcalypse_The_Clawmplete_Series/]our other games too![/url])

[previewyoutube=6U8ZiNcaCKk;full][/previewyoutube]

aside from that, the cool kid cody series got a big update! you can watch the youtube vid for the gist of it or read the changelog below. i'll be making a few more announcements related to the game, one [url=https://twitter.com/90PercentDenny]exclusively on twitter[/url], so if you wanna keep up, feel free to follow me there. anyway i think that's it for now, thanks so much for enjoying our dumb little games, it makes me so happy to make stuff like this and share it with yall. have an awesome rest of your day! ^u^

changelog (in no particular order, and in as much detail as possible)
[list]
[*]characters now have voice sound bites when they talk.
[*]animated text has been added throughout dialogue.
[*]some dialogue has been tweaked to fix typos or make more sense or be slightly more funny.
[*]extra behind the scenes art can be found in trash cans at random.
[*]speaking of, the info menu now has behind the scenes art along with controls and credits.
[*]a few new achievements have been added.
[*]you can explore a bit more freely in episodes 1 and 3, where originally you couldn't backtrack outside much.
[*]in episode 1 if you backtrack to alarmy after making it through the book fair. there's a new interaction with them.
[*]season and episode numbers are written below save and load slots.
[*]a few more sound effects were added, and all sound has been re-leveled to be on par with the other sound channels.
[*]some full screen THWACK effects have been swapped for POW and WHAM, just to mix it up.
[*]your cursor turns into a hand when hovering over something clickable.
[*]you can return items at steve's skateshop.
[*]renamed the "options" button to "settings" so it matches the label of the actual menu.
[*]removed holden's nose from his background sprite (he doesn't need it, he smells enough as is).
[*]one word of dialogue per episode now explodes after x amount of seconds.
[*]cody starts off episode 1 just named cody, for symbolism and poetics or whatever.
[*]in episode 1 once g-ma leaves the house, cody can blast britton spears on his tv all he wants.
[*]you can use the ESC button to close your phone and other menus.
[*]cody's proof of candidacy is now visible when he's winking during his handspring in episode 3.
[*]some character positioning on screen has changed (for example, if you click on the lefthand door at the bookfair, cody will be facing left, instead of originally he was always facing right).
[*]somehow you could click on page # on the load and save screens and straight up rename the page, with incorrect alignment. it was kinda messy so that's been removed.
[*]slanguage arts class has a filter over the music, mostly for a vibe change when entering the room.
[*]added secrets, but i won't get into details cuz they're secret, duh.
[*]edit: totally forgot to mention, added a skip overlay so when you skip, you really know you skip.
[*]edit: unarchived files so you can go into the folders and mess with images heheheh.
[/list]

hopefully that's it, there have been a lot of minor changes since working on the development of season 2, so apologies if i've missed something. if there are any bugs, feel free to @ me or dm me on twitter, we'll try and get things sorted asap!
